ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity dark field with distinct high-contrast white linear segment traversing the mid-section of the left lobe; high-intensity white clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped vertex with a measured pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees; vertical depth relative to lobe height is roughly 15%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge, with increased amplitude and density concentrated on the outer third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex arc from the median notch to the distal tips, following a roughly parabolic curve interrupted by secondary serration topography.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity white pixel groupings located on the distal margins and tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, prominent high-contrast white linear mark extending horizontally across the lower-middle portion of the left lobe lobe; additional smaller, less distinct linear pixel disruptions visible near the center-right region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A major linear white scar on the left lobe; irregular jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe located approximately 15% inward from the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, isolated high-intensity focal spot located approximately 20 pixels below the vertex of the median notch.
